newsitem.title: UK: Euro oil swaps mixed - CFDs up 5 cts, fuel falters.
newsitem.headline: Euro oil swaps mixed - CFDs up 5 cts, fuel falters.

text.p: European oil swaps were mixed on Friday morning as Brent CFDs edged higher but some oil products slipped.
Brent CFDs climbed about five cents a barrel for next week to 23 cents under July. The following three weeks at talked 21 cents, 20 cents and 19 cents under respectively.
Heavy fuel slipped $1 a tonne to $85.25 on June but low sulphur remained well supported from the United States.

Dealers said the contango remains steeply curved reflected downward pressure on nearby periods from summer exports of Russian fuel. The third to fourth quarter contango was assessed by brokers at $6 a tonne while the fourth to first quarter was an unusually wide nearer $4.
Gasoline slipped $1 a tonne to $204.00 for June but July remained some $4.50 below June, with August a further $3.50 lower.
Jet premiums were little changed although June edged up 50 cents to near $20 above the IPE.
Gas oil crack spreads held at $4.30 a barrel (3Q97), $4.85 (4Q97) and $4.75 (1Q98). -- Sam Arnold-Forster, London Newsroom +44 171 542 4984
